items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy, 
 safety shoes, ...etc.

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.

Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.

The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.

Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.

Complete maintenance tool 
 set.

Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.

Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.

Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.

Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 record them.

Check the vibration level of the pump set 
 complete with the motor then, record them.
Dismantle all attached pipes.

Unscrew the bolts of the electric motor feet 
 and take motor out .
Dismantle the pump half coupling.
Remove the air separator.

Unscrew the bolts of the two sides of bearing 
 carriers from the pump and take them out complete with bearings.

Unscrew the nut tightening the stuffing box 
 flange and withdraw flanges together with bearing.

Remove the cap body together with valve 
 distributing plate from the two sides of vacuum pump after unscrewing its 
 fastening screws.
Take off the complete vacuum pump rotor.

Remove the plotter valve by unscrewing the 
 screws in the inner side of valve distributing plate.

Check all components of the pump and replace 
 them by new ones if needed.

The validity of the anti-friction ball 
 bearings

Check all parts for any worn-out and replace 
 them by new ones.

Inspect the run-out of shafts (allowance 0.03 
 mm).

Assemble the valve distributing plates 
 (plotter valves after cleaning their openings ) with the pump cover.

Install one of the pump covers then insert the 
 shaft into it .

Mount the circulating wheel and sealing bushes 
 to the shaft.
Install the second cover of the pump.

Mount bearings with their carriers and tight 
 them to the pump (after greasing the bearings).
Install the pump half coupling.

Screw the electric motor bolts after adjusting 
 alignment.

Repack the stuffing boxes and tight them 
 easily by hand.
Install the air separator.
Install all attached pipes to the pump.

Check the direction of rotation of pump before 
 starting the pump for the first time.

Check the quantity of grease in the bearing 
 sump.

Check whether the inlet for flooding the 
 stuffing box is open.

Check whether the inlet for hydraulic sealing 
 of the suspension is open.
Check whether the delivery valve is closed.

Open the delivery valve gradually after the 
 set has been started to operate at its full speed.

The temperature of the anti-friction bearing 
 in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.

The oil level in bearing top according to the 
 mark on the oil gauge.
The temperature of cooling water at discharge.

Introduction
This document outlines 
 the major maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every five years as 
 indicated by Y5 in the above title block.
This pump is used for 
 drawing the leakage air from the circuit of cooling water.
Technical specification
Type of pump | 50 
 SZO 224 45 Sigma Zavadka
Design : | Horizontal with a separator
Drawn in medium | Air water vapors
Drawn in air volume | 41 m3 / h at abs. Pressure 10 
 kPa
Pump speed | 1450 r.p.m.
Input of air pump | 2.15 Kw
Type of motor | 4 AP 112 M
Motor output | 4.4 Kw
Motor speed | 1450 r.pm.
Voltage | 380 V / 50 Hz
Quantity of make up water | 0.48 m3 / h , pressure 150 
 kPa , abs.
Weight | 40 kg
Bearing Type: | 6303 - 3303
Material: | bronze impeller, body cast 
 iron, separator carbon steel

Isolate the circuit 
 breaker of the pump motor.
Disconnect electric 
 terminals of the pump motor.
The pump must be isolated 
 mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves.
Be sure pump must be 
 completely drained.
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool 
 set.
Cleaning fluid, Manual 
 puller.
Feeler gauge, Dial 
 indicator.
Vibrometer, Straight 
 edge.
Rags.
Work to be carried out
Pump in Operation
Check discharge quantity and pressure and 
 record them.
Check the vibration level of the pump set 
 complete with the motor then, record them.
Disassembly
Pump Out Of Operation
Dismantle all attached pipes.
Unscrew the bolts of the electric motor feet 
 and take motor out .
Dismantle the pump half coupling.
Remove the air separator.
Unscrew the bolts of the two sides of bearing 
 carriers from the pump and take them out complete with bearings.
Unscrew the nut tightening the stuffing box 
 flange and withdraw flanges together with bearing.
Remove the cap body together with valve 
 distributing plate from the two sides of vacuum pump after unscrewing its 
 fastening screws.
Take off the complete vacuum pump rotor.
Remove the plotter valve by unscrewing the 
 screws in the inner side of valve distributing plate.
Check all components of the pump and replace 
 them by new ones if needed.
Inspection
The validity of the anti-friction ball 
 bearings
Check all parts for any worn-out and replace 
 them by new ones.
Inspect the run-out of shafts (allowance 0.03 
 mm).
Assembly
Assemble the valve distributing plates 
 (plotter valves after cleaning their openings ) with the pump cover.
Install one of the pump covers then insert the 
 shaft into it .
Mount the circulating wheel and sealing bushes 
 to the shaft.
Install the second cover of the pump.
Mount bearings with their carriers and tight 
 them to the pump (after greasing the bearings).
Install the pump half coupling.
Screw the electric motor bolts after adjusting 
 alignment.
Repack the stuffing boxes and tight them 
 easily by hand.
Install the air separator.
Install all attached pipes to the pump.
Starting Of Pump
Check the direction of rotation of pump before 
 starting the pump for the first time.
Check the quantity of grease in the bearing 
 sump.
Check whether the inlet for flooding the 
 stuffing box is open.
Check whether the inlet for hydraulic sealing 
 of the suspension is open.
Check whether the delivery valve is closed.
Open the delivery valve gradually after the 
 set has been started to operate at its full speed.
Attendance and checking 
during operation
The temperature of the anti-friction bearing 
 in the bearing top which should not exceed 75C.
The oil level in bearing top according to the 
 mark on the oil gauge.
The temperature of cooling water at discharge.
